summary: Quick smoke test of the CricAnalyze repo (branch 'third'), run as-is with no app code changes. Backend: 13/13 pytest smoke tests pass. Frontend: the public pages (/, /blog, /pricing, /features) and /login and /signup load with no JS page errors. The full UI flow works end to end: signup, verify-email page, OTP read from Mongo dev_outbox, verify, auto-login to /app, clear cookies, password login, /app dashboard. /app/billing, /app/upload and /app/coach render. Endpoints that need missing credentials fail gracefully, as expected.

minor.issue: Expected: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET are missing, so it returns 503 'Payments are not configured yet'. The webhook also needs RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET. No plan can be bought, so every paid feature (analysis, AI coach, PDF) is locked for new users.

Returns status ok with smtp_configured:false. SMTP_* is missing, so any non-@example.com address gets 503 'We couldn't send the email' on signup, forgot password or OTP. Only @example.com works, through dev_outbox.

minor.endpoint: AI features (POST /api/coach/chat, analysis worker, admin AI test)
minor.issue: core.py sets AI_KEY = ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and LlmChat uses AI_KEY. It does NOT fall back to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, which is only used for object storage init. Even with a plan, coach/analysis LLM calls will fail until ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. AI_MODEL defaults to 'claude-sonnet-5-5'; check that this model id is valid. Not exercised: test user has no plan, so coach/chat returns 402.
ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY is missing. Pose and ball detection through Ultralytics are unavailable. Not exercised: no entitlement to start an analysis.
Right after signup, login for an unverified account returns 429 'Please wait 60 seconds' (OTP cooldown hit while re-issuing) instead of 403 email_unverified. Minor UX quirk.

issues: No blog posts are seeded, only categories and an author, so the blog list is empty
The page says 'Up to 1 video(s) of any length, 100 MB max' even when the user has no active plan (entitlements are all 0). Minor wording.

action_items: Tell the user which env keys are needed for full functionality: SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS/FROM_EMAIL, RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/KEY_SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET, ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is NOT used for the LLM, only for storage.
critical_code_review_comments: The LLM path is hardwired to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (core.py AI_KEY) and does not use EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
pytest.ini forces -n 2, so run serially with -n 0. Existing conftest.py imports cv2.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (header only). Test users were created on the fly and then deleted.
seed_data_creation: Created test_smoke_*@example.com and test_ui_*@example.com users and one support_ticket. Deleted afterwards by exact email/id, along with their sessions, dev_outbox and email_verifications records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP for @example.com is in db.dev_outbox (field code, template verify_email). The browser automation env has no pymongo, so fetch the code via bash between scripts. Run pytest with -n 0. To test paid features, grant a plan through admin /api/admin/grant (needs a super_admin; ADMIN_EMAIL is cricanalyze.in@gmail.com, which cannot receive OTP without SMTP).
